title: Extremal problems for cancellative and locally thin hypergraphs
summary: We study Turán-type extremal problems for cancellative and locally thin uniform hypergraphs. An $r$-uniform hypergraph is $t$-cancellative if $(\cup_{i=1}^t A_i)\cup B\ne (\cup_{i=1}^t A_i)\cup C$ whenever $A_1,\ldots,A_t,B,C$ are distinct edges. Let $C_t(n,r)$ denote the maximum number of edges in such a hypergraph on $n$ vertices. For all fixed integers $t,k\ge2$, we prove that $C_{2(t-1)}(n,tk)=(1+o(1))\frac{\binom{n}{k}}{\binom{tk-1}{k-1}}$ as $n\to\infty$.
